title: Canonical Correlation Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.07212v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relational inductive biases such as grids or graphs allow neural networks with fewer trainable parameters and improved generalization, but require a known structure beforehand. When no structure is available, the covariance matrix provides a principled substitute, and coVariance Neural Networks (VNNs) have shown that using it yields models that are theoretically grounded in Principal Component Analysis, stable to finite-sample estimation errors and parameter-efficient. This framework, however, is limited to single-view data, whereas many applications observe the same phenomenon through multiple views, each with its own in-view covariance and a cross-view covariance linking them. To incorporate these matrices as inductive biases in a principled way, we introduce CAnonical correlation NEural networks (CANEs), architectures that use in-view and cross-view covariances as distinct relational biases to solve downstream tasks. Via spectral anal

translated_abstract: 诸如网格或图等关系归纳偏置能够让神经网络以更少的可训练参数获得更好的泛化能力，但这需要事先已知数据结构。当没有可用结构时，协方差矩阵提供了一种有原则的替代方案，协方差神经网络已经表明，使用协方差矩阵可以构建在理论上以主成分分析（PCA）为基础、对有限样本估计误差稳定且参数高效的模型。然而，这一框架仅适用于单视图数据，而许多应用是通过多个视图来观察同一现象的，每个视图都有各自的视图内协方差，以及连接不同视图的跨视图协方差。为了以一种有原则的方式将这些矩阵作为归纳偏置引入网络，我们提出了典型相关神经网络，这是一类将视图内协方差和跨视图协方差作为不同关系偏置来解决下游任务的网络架构。通过谱分析……
tldr: 本文提出典型相关神经网络（CANEs），将视图内协方差和跨视图协方差作为不同的关系归纳偏置引入网络架构，把以PCA为理论基础、稳定且参数高效的协方差神经网络框架从单视图数据推广到了多视图场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Canonical Correlation Neural Networks (CANEs), which use in-view and cross-view covariances as distinct relational inductive biases, extending the theoretically grounded, stable, and parameter-efficient covariance neural network framework from single-view to multi-view data.
